ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.
   B. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   B. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   B. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   D. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)

   C. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

12. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   C. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

----
